title: Expected input cost of the randomized tree
statement: For every nine-coordinate sign vector $x\in\{\pm1\}^9$, the randomized decision tree's expected input cost equals the sum of the interleaved model costs over all depth-two seeds, divided by $81$.
hypotheses_covered: Input is a sign vector on nine coordinates
